args.body:
File: src/export/xlsx.ts

Update the `writeXlsx` function to check for and handle empty lines at the end of the data rows when importing.

label: bug
file: src/export/xlsx.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The code in `writeXlsx` does not currently handle empty lines at the end of the input data, which leads to a 'Malformed row' error during import.
